Container.Overview: Host-networked inkjet maintenance prints to help prevent nozzle clogs on Unraid.
Container.Description:
Inkjet Conditioner is a lightweight local printing utility built for Unraid. It automatically discovers LAN printers through Bonjour/mDNS and common print services, then schedules regular low-volume maintenance prints to help prevent inkjet nozzle clogs.
Host networking is required for reliable automatic printer detection because Bonjour/mDNS multicast and the fallback LAN scan need access to Unraid's LAN interface. Bridge, macvlan, ipvlan, and isolated networks may still print to manually configured printer IPs, but discovery is not guaranteed.
The app stores its config in persistent appdata and exposes a small web UI so you can confirm printer settings, test the print path, and adjust the schedule without editing container environment variables by hand.
